slices.focus: Caleb formalizes a post-approval retention routine with 30, 60, and 90 day check-ins and one named contact per approved household to prevent late-stage drift
slices.summary: Caleb realizes that getting households approved is not the finish line, as late-stage contractor confusion and closing paperwork still cause drop-off. He formalizes a retention routine with scheduled check-ins at 30, 60, and 90 days, each with a specific purpose (stabilize, re-engage, escalate), and assigns one named contact per household to prevent residents from bouncing between staff members.
